user.title: HA Operator
user.description: Create HA Operator, then add resources, policies, and airflow requirements. New resources start in observe mode. The global shadow lock is optional and defaults to off.

data.shadow_lock: Lock all resources in observe mode

data_description.shadow_lock: Prevent every resource from entering live mode. Turn off this lock before explicitly activating individual resources.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one HA Operator integration is needed.

user.title: Add resource
user.description: Choose physical outputs and independent feedback. Resources start in observe mode. Relay profiles must specify every output and include an all-off profile. Native fans require a default target object; relay fans require a default profile target object. See the examples in the documentation.

data_description.manual_control: Turn off for a follower controlled by a source. Removes managed command entities, manual status, expiry, and resume controls; manual request actions are rejected.
data_description.return_monitor: For covers, warn when raw position has not reached the effective return target. Uses the configured position tolerance.
data_description.kind: Choose the source integration adapter. A relay fan owns every listed switch output exclusively.
data_description.entity_id: Use the raw cover, switch, or fan from its source integration. Covers need non-optimistic position feedback and position control.
data_description.outputs: For relay fans only. Every profile must specify true or false for every listed switch. No other resource can own these outputs.
data_description.profiles: Map profile names to an outputs object containing switch entity IDs and boolean states. Include an all-off profile and an on profile.
data_description.default_target: Native fans require an on target, optionally with a percentage. Relay fans require an on profile target. This is the fan ON command default, not an automatic baseline policy.
data_description.reversal_dead_time: Relay fans require 0.001 to 3600 seconds with every output off before changing direction. Choose a value permitted by the motor and relay hardware.
data_description.restriction_entity: Only the on state blocks the restricted target. Missing or unknown restriction feedback also prevents unsafe dispatch; it does not erase accepted intent.
data_description.fault_entity: On inhibits dispatch. Missing, unknown, restored, or optimistic feedback also inhibits commands.
data_description.retry_interval: Positive seconds between retries when the device does not reach the target. Defaults to 300. Source updates do not renew an accepted expiry.
data_description.command_interval: Positive seconds between normal commands for one resource. Defaults to 30. A supported STOP invalidates pending commands and bypasses this interval.
data_description.movement_timeout: Positive seconds to defer another command while raw feedback reports movement. Defaults to 120. A target-not-reached decision can already exist; this guard bounds the wait before retry.
data_description.manual_duration: Positive seconds for a manual lease when no duration or absolute expiry is supplied. Defaults to 1800. Expiry withdraws the override; a policy must supply any return target.
data_description.tolerance: Allowed cover-position difference from the target, from 0 to 100 percentage points. Defaults to 2. Independent physical feedback remains required.

user.title: Add policy
user.description: Choose a resource and fixed target or native target source. Occurrence policies run only when submitted with an identity and expiry.

data_description.input_type: Keep the existing input, or configure a qualified sensor or timer. Remove helper eligibility fields when switching to a native input.
data_description.resource_id: Subentry ID of the existing resource that owns this output.
data_description.kind: State policies remain eligible while their source qualifies. Occurrence policies need a distinct, bounded event submitted by an action or native timer input.
data_description.priority: Integer from -1000000 to 1000000; larger values win among eligible policies. Defaults to 0. Manual leases and airflow requirements have separate precedence.
data_description.target: Target object for the resource, such as position set to 0 or on set to true. A target source or desired control can supply a dynamic target instead.
data_description.eligibility_entity: Optional source entity that must match Eligibility state. A native input replaces these eligibility fields.
data_description.eligibility_state: Exact source state required for eligibility. Defaults to on when an eligibility entity is supplied. Missing or unknown feedback does not qualify.
data_description.target_entity: Read the target from this source entity state or its configured attribute. Telemetry does not create manual ownership.
data_description.target_attribute: Optional source attribute. Omit to read the source state; requires a target entity.
data_description.target_field: Target field to populate: position, on, percentage, or direction. Defaults to position; requires a target entity and matching resource capability.
data_description.intent_id: Desired control subentry ID for a state policy controlling a switch. Replaces all other target fields; uses the current Boolean value.

qualified_numeric.title: Qualify a numeric source
qualified_numeric.description: Activate this state policy after the sensor stays below the threshold for the qualification delay. The unit must exactly match the source. Unknown readings preserve the episode. After restart, a fresh numeric report is required.

timer_episode.title: Accept a timer episode
timer_episode.description: A fresh timer start qualifies one expiring request. Pause or cancel withdraws it. Resume does not create a new opening. Natural timer completion keeps an accepted request until its own expiry.

user.title: Add requirement
user.description: Providers are an ordered list with id, optional resource_id and target, and evidence predicates. Every predicate must confirm physical state. An unmet requirement notifies and tries alternatives; it never stops extraction.

data_description.activation_entities: The requirement activates only when all listed sources are on. Unknown activation remains unknown. This requirement never turns extraction off.
data_description.providers: Ordered list of providers with unique id and independent evidence predicates. An active provider also needs resource_id and target. A passive provider has evidence only. Every predicate must match before airflow is confirmed.
data_description.acquisition_timeout: Positive seconds allowed to confirm a provider before considering alternatives. Defaults to 120. Commands alone do not confirm airflow.

user.title: Add desired control
user.description: A persistent on/off source with no manual lease. Turning it on from off also turns on its configured dependents. Turning it off leaves them unchanged. Initial value applies only when first created; reload does not replay an on edge.

data.name: Name
data.on_targets: Also turn on these desired controls

data_description.initial_value: Required explicit true or false. Used only when no saved value exists; changing it does not overwrite saved intent.
data_description.on_targets: Optional desired control IDs set on in the same state update when this control changes from off to on. Repeated on and switching off do not change dependents. References must exist and remain acyclic.

storage_error.title: HA Operator restored data is unusable
storage_error.description: HA Operator could not set up because restored runtime data is invalid. Check the Home Assistant logs for the validation error. Keep a Home Assistant backup before recovery, and use a matching backup if restoring saved state. After resolving the error, select Reload from the integration menu. The Repair clears when setup succeeds. Ordinary Store write errors are reported in Home Assistant logs.

init.description: Changes reload the integration after existing workers stop. A shadow lock prevents device commands; recording-only entities remain observation inputs.

data_description.shadow_lock: Prevent every resource from entering live mode. Unlocking first saves all resource modes as observe; explicitly select live for each resource after unlocking.

error.unlock_unavailable: The shadow lock is still enabled. Reload HA Operator and wait for it to finish loading before trying to unlock again. Resources must be saved in observe mode before unlocking.
